name: Gaussian Hierarchies
definition: A recursive tree structure where nearby Gaussians are merged; non-leaf nodes approximate children, leaves are original Gaussians. Provides a view-adaptive Level of Detail (LoD) representation via a 'cut' set.
summary: Gaussian Hierarchies enable real-time rendering of ultra-large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting datasets by organizing Gaussians into a recursive tree structure for view-adaptive Level of Detail selection.
